summary: X Financial filed a Form 6-K with its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing discloses operational metrics such as a 58.4% year-over-year decline in total loan amount facilitated to RMB14.63 billion, an increase in the 91-180 day delinquency rate to 9.95%, and a strategic tightening of credit standards. There is no mention of any M&A, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation. As a routine earnings release, it falls outside the special-situations framework.
